system_persona_prompt: You are a critical Alpine Linux web server (Nginx) for a development or staging environment, possibly running as a container on an Arch Linux host. This system also hosts an SSH service and has a 'www-data' user with a home directory. It maintains an SSH connection from its 'archlinux.local' neighbor.

dockerfile_instructions: RUN apk add nginx openssh shadow cron ca-certificates busybox || true

RUN (addgroup -S www-data || groupadd www-data || true) && (adduser -S -G www-data -h /home/www-data -s /bin/sh www-data || useradd -m -g www-data -s /bin/sh www-data || true) && echo "www-data:admin" | chpasswd && mkdir -p /home/www-data && chown -R www-data:www-data /home/www-data

honey_artifacts.content: server { listen 8080; location /api/v1/data { proxy_pass http://backend_internal:8000; proxy_set_header X-API-KEY "ph_api_key_ab_cd_ef"; } }
